mapper.insert: INSERT INTO risk_score (underpass_id, risk_score, rainfall_mm, rainfall_1h_mm, rainfall_3h_mm, rainfall_6h_mm, rainfall_12h_mm, rainfall_24h_mm, predicted_at) VALUES (#{underpassId}, #{riskScore}, #{rainfallMm}, #{rainfall1hMm}, #{rainfall3hMm}, #{rainfall6hMm}, #{rainfall12hMm}, #{rainfall24hMm}, #{predictedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT risk_score, rainfall_mm, rainfall_1h_mm, rainfall_3h_mm, rainfall_6h_mm, rainfall_12h_mm, rainfall_24h_mm, predicted_at FROM risk_score WHERE underpass_id = #{underpassId} AND predicted_at >= NOW() - make_interval(hours => #{hours}) ORDER BY predicted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
